g.text: Contextual annotations; none has BH FDR < 0.05
D2 paths to all 7 observed query hits
Display threshold >=1/4 is a coverage choice, not a significance cutoff
Thick black border: mitochondrial query hit at >=1/4
Node size and x/4 show neighborhood recurrence
U1-U2 nodes are upstream context; D1-D2 nodes lie downstream; arrows follow the Bayesian-network direction
